statement: ∀ (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (d a b : ℝ), 0 ≤ d → Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal d → b - a ≤ d → Metric.ediam {z : YuiEucl (n+1) | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ Set.Icc a b} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 2 * d)
proof:
intro U d a b hd hU hab
apply Metric.ediam_le_of_forall_dist_le
intro z hz w hw
have hdist : dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w) ≤ d := by
  have h := Metric.edist_le_ediam_of_mem hz.1 hw.1
  rw [edist_dist] at h
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hd).mp (h.trans hU)
have hlast : |YuiLast z - YuiLast w| ≤ d := by
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> linarith [hz.2.1, hz.2.2, hw.2.1, hw.2.2]
have hformula : dist z w = Real.sqrt ((dist (YuiHead z) (YuiHead w))^2 + |YuiLast z - YuiLast w|^2) := by
  conv_lhs => rw [← (h_T003 n).2.1 z, ← (h_T003 n).2.1 w]
  exact (h_T003 n).2.2.1 _ _ _ _
rw [hformula]
exact yui_aux_0003 n E h_T003 h_T007 _ _ _ dist_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hd hdist hlast

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            ∀ (r ε : ℝ),
              0 < r →
                r ≤ 1 →
                  0 < ε →
                    ∃ T U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : ↑T), (U i).Nonempty ∧ 0 < Metric.ediam (U i) ∧ Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) ∧
                          YuiCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
      ∀ (U : Set (YuiEucl n)) (d a b : ℝ),
        0 ≤ d →
          Metric.ediam U ≤ ENNReal.ofReal d →
            b - a ≤ d → Metric.ediam {z | YuiHead z ∈ U ∧ YuiLast z ∈ Set.Icc a b} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (√2 * d)
